_doc: Сцена поиска П0/1, приёмная клиники. Строится из X:/PDGame/Tools/layouts/P0_Reception.json. rect = x, y, ширина, высота в пикселях фона 1472x1024. Шаги: 6_SCENE.bat, отбор, 7_SCENE_ITEMS.bat, отбор. characters — персонажи: в картину не рисуются, в игре это отдельные актёры (анимация), behind — мебель перед персонажем: в игре её часть вырезается из картины и рисуется поверх него.
title: П0, сцена 1: приёмная клиники, 19:10
scene_prompt: reception room of a private clinic in the evening. Redraw the reference picture as one finished hand-drawn cartoon illustration in a single consistent style. Keep the camera and the layout exactly: the walls, the window with the evening sky and curtains, the white door, the blue rug and every piece of furniture stay at the same place and size. Redraw everything cleanly in the correct perspective of the two receding walls: each piece of furniture stands firmly on the floor exactly where its soft ellipse shadow lies. Replace the large grey box in the corner with a classic wooden writing desk with two symmetrical drawer pedestals and a knee hole between them; replace the small grey box by the left wall with a small wooden bedside cabinet with one drawer. The curtain rod is one straight horizontal rod with a finial only at each end. The white panel door has a symmetrical frosted glass insert across its upper half and one round wooden handle on the door leaf, not on the frame. The light switch lies flat on the wall in the walls perspective. Replace the grey oval on the right wall with a round wooden wall clock with a dark red rim and a white face, hanging flat on the receding wall and foreshortened to match its perspective, never drawn front-on. The framed painting and the wooden shelf also hang flat on the right wall in its perspective. The blue rug lies flat on the parquet floor in the same perspective as the floor, with fringe on both short edges; the herringbone parquet keeps an even consistent pattern. The blue office chair has a clear five-star base with casters. The only light is the warm ceiling lamp: every piece of furniture casts one soft shadow on the floor, consistent with that single lamp. Unify the line thickness, colours and shading of everything. Nobody is in the room: no people, the space behind the desk is empty. No small loose objects on the desk, floor or windowsill. The floor and the rug are clean: no smudges, stains or stray dark patches, every shadow is soft and clean. No text, no letters, no dark border lines at the image edges.
